quotes.text: When adding an ESPHOME device to HA, the names of objects from these devices are concatenated with the name of the device itself. This behavior is not obvious and duplicates the setting in the ESPHOME - friendly_name itself in the esphome block https://esphome.io/components/esphome.html?highlight=friendly_name#configuration-variables .

medium: The reversion addresses inconsistencies in entity ID generation stemming from differing friendly name configurations and device naming conventions.

card.what: This line checks if the device's friendly name is empty, preventing an error.
card.why: The code was initially designed to handle ESPHome entity naming, specifically when the friendly name isn't set. answer: Legacy naming makes entity IDs in Home Assistant match the IDs set in ESPHome, a feature built for ESPHome.
